# Pushify

> Pushify is an open-source, self-hostable PaaS (Platform-as-a-Service) — a
> self-hosted alternative to Coolify, Vercel, Heroku, Render, and Railway. It lets
> developers deploy web applications to their own VPS servers in under 60 seconds,
> without configuration. Pushify runs on servers you own — provisioned through
> Hetzner Cloud or any custom VPS — so your data never touches third-party
> infrastructure. MIT-licensed. Supports 20+ frameworks including Next.js, React,
> Vue.js, Nuxt, Svelte, Astro, Remix, Node.js, Python, Go, and Laravel.

## Key Pages

## Deployment Guides

- [Deploy Next.js](https://pushify.dev/deploy/nextjs): Deploy Next.js 15 with automatic SSL and zero-downtime cutover
- [Deploy React](https://pushify.dev/deploy/react): Deploy React/Vite single-page apps
- [Deploy Vue](https://pushify.dev/deploy/vue): Deploy Vue and Nuxt applications
- [Deploy Node.js](https://pushify.dev/deploy/nodejs): Deploy Node.js services with env vars and port binding
- [Deploy Python](https://pushify.dev/deploy/python): Deploy Django/FastAPI/Flask apps
- [Deploy Laravel](https://pushify.dev/deploy/laravel): Deploy Laravel with queue workers and scheduler

## Core Features

- Push-to-deploy from GitHub with framework auto-detection
- Managed VPS servers via Hetzner Cloud (5+ regions) or custom servers
- One-click databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB with automated backups
- CLI tool for terminal-based deployments (npm: pushify-cli)
- Automatic SSL certificates via Let's Encrypt
- Zero-downtime deploys with instant rollbacks
- Team collaboration and role-based access
- Marketplace with 24+ ready-to-deploy apps (WordPress, Supabase, Appwrite, etc.)
- Real-time monitoring and server metrics

## Comparison Guides

- [Pushify vs Coolify](https://pushify.dev/vs/coolify): Two open-source self-hosted PaaS platforms compared — managed cloud provisioning, team billing, site builder, marketplace, and pricing
- [Pushify vs Vercel](https://pushify.dev/vs/vercel): A self-hosted, own-your-infrastructure alternative to Vercel — features and total cost compared

Pushify is comparable to Vercel, Railway, Render, Heroku, and Coolify, with the
key distinction of running on user-owned infrastructure. Unlike managed
platforms, Pushify gives developers full control over their servers and data.
For a full self-contained overview, see https://pushify.dev/llms-full.txt

## CLI Installation

```
npm install -g pushify-cli
```
